objective: maximize cumulative profit and learning speed while minimizing user intervention
nonNegotiables: Do not reactivate Amazon KDP or LINE Creators Market without explicit user instruction.
Do not ask the user to perform repetitive browser or patch-test work.
Do not publish plaintext paid assets to public GitHub.
Do not fabricate sales, reviews, public URLs, demand, testimonials, or platform capabilities.
Do not optimize for item count; optimize for profit, average order value, and evidence quality.
Do not buy ads or add recurring software costs before organic product-market evidence exists.

BOOTH.currentFeeRule: verify official fee every run; current official download fee observed 5.6% of item price + 45 JPY per order, decimals rounded up

offerLadder.teamLicense: 4980-9800 JPY only after B2B utility or sales evidence

note.role: paid knowledge product plus discovery channel
note.rule: free section must solve one concrete problem; paid section must contain reusable assets, criteria, cases, templates, or prompts

GitHubPages.role: free search-intent tools and evergreen acquisition
GitHubPages.rule: each tool must solve a complete small problem without external data transmission; add paid CTA only after the exact paid public URL is verified

revenueLevers.action: Create differentiated practical digital tools with a market score >= 70/100.
When two complementary products are live, create a bundle 10-20% below standalone total to raise average order value.
Create one useful search-intent free tool per meaningful paid-product problem, not one per SKU.
Publish problem-focused note articles around high-intent themes; cross-sell only to verified live relevant products.
After a relevant paid product is live and the category has enough value, create at most one genuinely useful free Lite BOOTH product to build shop followers and future new-product exposure.
revenueLevers.trigger: paid public URL verified and no existing free Lite for that buyer problem

revenueLevers.action: For event, sponsor, NPO, student-organization, or business-operation products, add an organization/team license product only when B2B utility is obvious and either a standalone sale is observed or two complementary live products exist.
revenueLevers.pricing: roughly 3-5x individual price, justified by multi-user rights rather than duplicated files

revenueLevers.action: Prepare meaningful version improvements for products with proven demand or buyer issues. BOOTH supports replacing download files and past buyers can re-download current files; do not create fake new editions merely to reset visibility.
Evaluate note membership or Payhip membership only after repeat-demand evidence. Do not create a subscription whose value requires constant low-quality filler.
revenueLevers.trigger: at least 10 strong related articles/products plus at least 5 observed paid buyers or clear repeat-purchase evidence

revenueLevers.action: Consider Payhip before Gumroad for English/localized mirrors after domestic validation because Payhip offers a free plan with 5% platform transaction fee and built-in bundles/referrals/affiliates; account/payment setup remains a one-time human step.
revenueLevers.trigger: at least 3 paid sales across at least 2 products or 5000 JPY observed monthly revenue, plus a product with plausible non-Japanese demand

revenueLevers.action: Do not add unrelated affiliate links while traffic is unproven. Re-evaluate only after free tools show meaningful traffic and only promote directly relevant services with clear disclosure.

scaleRules: If one product gets >=2 sales within 14 days, prioritize one complementary product or bundle over unrelated themes.
If a category gets >=5 cumulative sales, create one free Lite funnel if absent and evaluate a team license where appropriate.
If two products in a category both sell, freeze unrelated expansion temporarily and deepen that category.
If 30 days pass with zero observed sales in a category, do not create near-duplicates; change buyer problem, positioning, or category.
If buyer complaints or refunds reveal a product defect, prioritize quality repair over new product creation.

measurement.analyticsUpgrade: After at least two live BOOTH products, recommend one-time GA4 connection because BOOTH officially supports Google Analytics for page/conversion analysis; do not force setup before there is enough inventory to justify it.

channelDecisions.Gumroad: lower-priority-expansion because current direct-sale fee stack is materially higher
channelDecisions.printOnDemandMerch: deprioritized due weak audience fit with current practical-template portfolio
channelDecisions.customServices: deprioritized because they create ongoing user labor instead of passive delivery
